topics.title: Dutch Bros offer
topics.what: Counter offer for Senior Engineer, Data / HQ convert.
topics.summary: Offer $135k base + $1.2k Mafia + $1.2k cell + $5k RSUs; bonus eligible no %; 401k contribute ~30 days, match after 1yr+1000hrs. He emailed Chloe (Phil may CC) asking $150k base; downplays Mafia/cell; asked if May contract time counts for match. Chloe replied 10/2: package is under review, update promised by EOD Tue 10/6; 401(k) service clock starts at FTE conversion (contractor time does not count).
topics.leftOff: Waiting on Chloe's package update (promised EOD Tue 10/6; follow up if nothing yet). Contract time won't count toward 401(k) match, so use that as leverage. Call script: hold $150k; bridge with sign-on $10–15k + ~10% written bonus if base stuck.
